# Independent admission gap controls

These fixtures were authored from the frozen public admission formula/model and existing literal source helpers. Neither reviewer implementation nor a design/production calculator was read or executed. No expected resource result comes from implementation output. Source helpers compute SHA256 only to construct internally consistent invitation input; this is not a score oracle. Root owns formatting, execution and survivor evidence.

## Effective contexts

1. Joined plan: the minimal used account_name declaration has length12, so incoming M is28. Add1000 dollar bytes as500 escaped pairs in Body. Its existing Summary has one more dollar; incoming charging is small. A local Text answer of10000 lowercase a bytes makes actual joined M at least10000. Body TextExtra alone is1000*10000=10000000, whose factor8 is80000000>B, independent of every other nonnegative term. The actual Body remains500 literal dollars and the actual Summary would contain only10005 bytes; no large allocation is needed to reach the conservative charge. A1000-byte answer has only1001000 total TextExtra over Body/Summary; all other held sources and one-candidate terms put its complete score below10MiB. The unjoined incoming score remains below1MiB. Both values are ordinary nonsecret lowercase string answers, not defaults or invalid types.

2. Proposed Record root: the existing hand-derived public formula is58800+152*d+16*m. At d440000/m10599, full incoming Score is B−480 and raw archive length451468. Retain exact60-byte identity preparation; decoded preparation is unchanged, while E grows60 and Score grows480 to B. A single extra local LF changes only E and makes the score B+8. Correct effective admission therefore refuses. Substituting zero Record for actual seed would reduce W from974 to904, subtracting560 after the factor8 and wrongly admitting B−552. Omitting preparation also wrongly admits; this witness intentionally does not claim to isolate the Record omission from every other possible context defect.

3. Selected Preparation root: reuse the same inclusive-B retained60-byte positive. Add100 local LF bytes rather than one; decoded preparation remains unchanged and effective Score becomes B+800. Replacing nonnil selected Preparation W1177 with nil-pointer W64 subtracts8904, wrongly admitting B−8104. A zero-Record-only mistake still gives B+240 and refuses, so this second source-only witness distinguishes the preparation omission even from that other candidate defect. Incoming and cheap local guards remain unchanged in both pairs. All lengths/formulas are hand-derived; no product score is asserted through an estimator API.

## Simple cardinalities

Every over-cap input has its count increased by one with the same bounded literal shape. Lower controls are exactly at the inclusive cap and semantically usable, not merely within a proposed estimator's domain. IDs are unique lowercase/digit slugs; variable names are unique legal default-onboarder names; prose is nonblank; empty optional steps are valid; Ask-only checks are meaningful; contact email c@x is synthetic and satisfies the actual validator's bounded shape; vacant roles produce warnings, not refusal. Matching identity-only seed/preparation sources are retained.

| Counter pair | Independent nonmasking bounds |
| -- | -- |
| Sections256/257 | Each section has19 W occurrences and W1224 (ID length5, one-byte Title/Summary), no variables/clauses. Base+Render plus32*S*S is below8MiB for both. Other counts remain far below their caps. |
| Variables1024/1025 | Each declaration has17 W occurrences and W1106 with seven-byte Name; every name has only its own absent-default pool. Candidate weight775, no directory, no clauses, PairWork32*Q*Q. Sources below20KiB and complete score below51MiB for both. This uses root onboarder questions, not same-name suggestion multiplication. |
| Steps4096/4097 | Zero Step has12 W occurrences and W768; Render counts the same steps a second time. Complete score stays below52MiB; occurrences below50000, known entries below5000, source below50KiB. |
| Checks8192/8193 | Each one-byte Ask Check has4 W occurrences and W257. Base/Render duplication plus source stays below40MiB; occurrences below33000 and known entries below8300. One held Step and Section avoid another cap. |
| Contacts2048/2049 | Each contact has6 W occurrences and W393 (five-byte ID, one-byte Name, three-byte email). No candidates/rendered directory references exist. Complete score below8MiB; combined directory count below4096. |

Local source below400000 bytes, occurrences below29000, known entries below4200; Base plus Render with200 per outcome stays below45MiB. The negative reaches the cheap review.record-admission cap before history/reconciliation; the positive requires all4096 actual history rows. |

All these forests are shallow (depth below10), with no unknown-data fanout, holder/options/Value.List/predicate-list elements or conditions. Caps and the independently bounded score therefore do not mask the listed one-over-limit witnesses. Stated MiB figures are coarse charged-score inequalities, not allocator/RSS measurements. Larger total-list/clauses/occurrence/known-entry caps are deliberately not claimed covered by this batch.
